newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - Hardie Firmandale exposure up again.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - Hardie Firmandale exposure up again.

text.p: James Hardie Industries Ltd said on Tuesday the total after tax provision for its exposure to Firmandale Investments Ltd had risen to A$65 million.
This was due to a further decline in Firmandale's net asset value based on its final accounts for the year ended March 31, Hardie told the Australian Stock Exchange (ASX).
As a result, Hardie now considered that its after tax exposure had increased by A$1.2 million, it said.

"This increase in exposure, combined with the A$8.8 million announced to the ASX on 25 June 1996, will result in an increase of A$15.7 million in James Hardie's provision for the potential loss under the guarantee in its accounts for the half-year to 30 September 1996, taking the total provision to A$65.0 million," Hardie said.
The exposure arises under third party guarantee given in connection with the funding of Firmandale's investment in American Endeavour Fund Ltd (AEF).

James Hardie said that consistent with its approach to date, the increase in exposure would be taken into account when it reviewed provisions for potential loss under the guarantee in accounts for the half year to September 30.
James Hardie shares closed steady at A$3.20.
